bayesian_dynamic_logit.known_risk: priors and posterior approximation frozen pre-result
bayesian_dynamic_logit.probability_contract: posterior predictive directional probability integrated over coefficient posterior
bayesian_dynamic_logit.uncertainty_contract: entropy of posterior predictive directional probability; also report posterior spread when available

change_point_segment_model.known_risk: all segment boundaries used at time t must have been detectable by t
change_point_segment_model.probability_contract: integrate segment-conditional directional forecasts over the causal segment posterior; no retrospectively revised break dates
change_point_segment_model.raw_output: causal segment posterior/change-point score and segment-conditional predictions
change_point_segment_model.uncertainty_contract: entropy of the integrated directional predictive distribution

elastic_net_logistic.known_risk: penalty and class weight cannot be tuned on evaluation rows
elastic_net_logistic.probability_contract: sigmoid of train-fitted model; all scaling and penalty selection inner-training-only
elastic_net_logistic.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

extra_trees.known_risk: tree count, depth and calibration frozen by config before evaluation
extra_trees.probability_contract: mean class probability over trees; optional calibration only in inner chronological folds
extra_trees.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; no claim that it is a complete epistemic interval

generalized_additive_model.known_risk: basis and smoothness selection remain inner-training-only
generalized_additive_model.probability_contract: family-link inverse plus training-only calibration if needed
generalized_additive_model.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

gradient_boosting.known_risk: boosting iterations and early stopping determined without outer validation
gradient_boosting.probability_contract: native link output or inner-fold-only probability calibration
gradient_boosting.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; does not assert full model uncertainty

hidden_markov_model.known_risk: filtered state probabilities only; no smoothed/future-informed states
hidden_markov_model.probability_contract: compute future directional predictive probability by integrating transition/emission uncertainty over filtered state posterior; do not classify the latent state as the target
hidden_markov_model.raw_output: filtered hidden-state posterior and state-conditional emission/transition quantities
hidden_markov_model.uncertainty_contract: entropy of the integrated future directional predictive distribution

histogram_gradient_boosting.known_risk: binning, early stopping and all fitted transforms are training-only
histogram_gradient_boosting.probability_contract: native link output or inner-fold-only probability calibration
histogram_gradient_boosting.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; does not assert full model uncertainty

kernel_svm.known_risk: no probability fit on outer validation/test data
kernel_svm.probability_contract: Platt calibration trained on inner-chronological out-of-fold margins only
kernel_svm.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy after inner-only calibration

knn_density_ratio.known_risk: density bandwidth/neighbour count and priors must be training-only
knn_density_ratio.probability_contract: convert density ratio to posterior using class priors estimated on the same training fold; then calibration diagnostics in inner folds
knn_density_ratio.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy after train-only posterior conversion/calibration

lda.known_risk: covariance regularization fit in training folds only
lda.probability_contract: normalized class posterior from training-fitted discriminants; calibration checked inner-fold-only
lda.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

logistic_regression.known_risk: all transforms and class weights fit on inner training rows only
logistic_regression.probability_contract: sigmoid of training-fitted logit; inner-fold-only calibration if calibration is required
logistic_regression.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

markov_switching_logit.known_risk: filtering, not smoothing; state count and priors frozen before evaluation
markov_switching_logit.probability_contract: integrate regime-specific directional probabilities over filtered regime posterior
markov_switching_logit.raw_output: latent-regime posterior plus regime-specific directional probabilities
markov_switching_logit.uncertainty_contract: entropy of integrated directional predictive distribution; state posterior may be reported separately

nearest_centroid.known_risk: centroids/scaling and calibration fit inside training folds only
nearest_centroid.probability_contract: Platt calibration of the signed train-only distance contrast using inner-chronological out-of-fold predictions
nearest_centroid.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy after inner-only calibration

probit_regression.known_risk: latent-score scaling and calibration must not use validation rows
probit_regression.probability_contract: standard-normal CDF of training-fitted score; calibration assessed within inner training folds
probit_regression.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

qda.known_risk: class covariance estimates and any regularization fit in training folds only
qda.probability_contract: normalized class posterior from training-fitted discriminants; calibration checked inner-fold-only
qda.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; abstention cutoff chosen in inner training only

random_forest.known_risk: tree count, depth and calibration frozen by config before evaluation
random_forest.probability_contract: mean class probability over trees; optional calibration only in inner chronological folds
random_forest.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy; no claim that it is a complete epistemic interval

shallow_mlp.known_risk: seed, epoch count, scaling and early stopping rules frozen in config
shallow_mlp.probability_contract: softmax/sigmoid followed by calibration only in inner chronological training folds
shallow_mlp.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy only; ensemble/dropout uncertainty is not assumed

survival_first_passage.known_risk: BLOCK: first-passage/censoring estimand not preregistered and validated
survival_first_passage.probability_contract: not compatible with present fixed-horizon up/down label contract until event, censoring and horizon estimands are reconciled
survival_first_passage.raw_output: discrete-time competing-risk hazards and cumulative incidences
survival_first_passage.uncertainty_contract: not approved under current directional-class estimand

temporal_convolution_network.known_risk: strict causal receptive field and chronological inner calibration required
temporal_convolution_network.probability_contract: softmax/sigmoid followed by calibration only in inner chronological training folds
temporal_convolution_network.uncertainty_contract: predictive Bernoulli entropy only; ensemble/dropout uncertainty is not assumed

conformal_set_decision.rationale: BLOCK: temporal calibration/validity argument and executable coverage tests are not frozen
conformal_set_decision.rule: emit a prediction set with target coverage

cost_sensitive_threshold.rationale: BLOCK: no scientifically justified directional error-cost matrix is pre-registered; trading/economic costs belong to the later strategy gate
cost_sensitive_threshold.rule: threshold minimizing expected loss under a frozen asymmetric cost matrix

probability_threshold.rationale: directly matches the directional probability target when probability semantics are valid
probability_threshold.rule: emit probability plus class using frozen 0.5 threshold

regime_gated_decision.rationale: requires a time-available regime posterior or the explicit entropy_regime_state representation and training-only gate threshold
regime_gated_decision.rule: apply a causal regime gate, then directional probability decision

uncertainty_abstention.rationale: fixed target coverage makes selective prediction interpretable; also report actual outer-fold coverage and selective log loss
uncertainty_abstention.rule: abstain on the 20% highest predictive-entropy cases; cutoff estimated only within inner chronological training folds

required_gate: A row may be fitted only after its family/operator adapter, causal timestamps, calibration/uncertainty semantics, and numerical tests pass in the independent tester gate. This matrix does not grant execution permission.
